facts.business: The company manufactures Single Super Phosphate (SSP) fertilizer, Sulphuric Acid, and other chemicals, with its main business segment related to agriculture.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Focus this year is to bring down the inventory levels and reduce carrying costing.

key_risks: Main business segment is related to agriculture and greatly affected by monsoons
Highly dependent on imported raw material
Substantial import of finished products other than SSP
facts.related_party_note: No trade receivables due from directors or other officers of the Company or any of them either severally or jointly with any other person. Further no trade receivables due from firms including LLPs or private limited companies in which any director is a partner, a director or a member.
